get.description: Admin-only check that Holvi accepts the registered key: authenticates over SFTP and counts /from_holvi without reading or moving files. ResponseCode 30 means the key is not (yet) registered with Holvi.

delete.description: Admin-only Holvi SFTP connection. The server generates the Ed25519 key, stores it KMS-encrypted and returns only the OpenSSH public key to register with Holvi. PUT and DELETE require If-Match with the current Version (absent for a new connection); a stale version is refused. Rotate the key by DELETE then PUT. SourceAddresses lists the fixed public IPv4 addresses for Holvi's allow-list; the key is also listed in ListCerts SftpKeys.
